chunks: It is narrated from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man sells dirhams for dinars on credit. He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.الدَّرَاهِمَ: silver coins used as a monetary unit
key_terms.الدَّنَانِيرِ: gold coins used as a monetary unit
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.نَسِيئَةً: on deferred payment or credit terms

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell dirhams for dinars on credit in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on currency exchange involving dirhams and dinars when conducted on deferred payment terms. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that such a transaction is permissible and there is no harm in it.
